lastCompletedStory.title: Introduce BackendAdapter interface + ClaudeAdapter with per-actor golden characterization tests

openQuestions: The follow-up codex-adapter implementation issue still needs to pick between the two ADR-0047-recorded directions for the claude-transcript-coupled token-ceiling backstop (loop.ts:1189): a codex transcript equivalent for readWorkerTokens, or documented graceful degradation.

readBackend's upgrade from a single top-level key to a per-phase accessor (mirroring readPhaseModel) is decided in ADR-0047 but not implemented; the implementation issue must also decide the backward-compat shape for existing single-key project.toml files.

The four existing builders (buildImplementerWorkerArgv, buildPlannerWorkerArgv, buildAuditorWorkerArgv, buildReviewerWorkerArgv) and their real call sites (loop.ts, plan-runner.ts, review.ts's makeReviewDispatch) are still unrerouted per this story's AC3; a follow-up story must decide whether/how to reroute call sites through ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv now that the seam exists, or whether the seam stays adapter-only until a codex adapter actually needs dispatch to branch on backend.
nextStoryContext: US-002 delivered src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts: BackendAdapter interface + ClaudeAdapter, with buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts) as the ONE concrete method (model/agentName/permissionMode/isolation/taskPrompt are INPUTS on SpawnArgvOptions, not separate methods), per ADR-0047. ClaudeAdapter internally DELEGATES to the four existing pure builders (buildImplementerWorkerArgv/buildPlannerWorkerArgv/buildAuditorWorkerArgv/buildReviewerWorkerArgv) rather than reimplementing them, so byte-for-byte parity with today's behavior is structural, not just tested -- proven by 8 golden tests in test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts (2 per actor: defaults + all-optionals-set) plus 2 adapter-contract guard tests (throws when implementer/planner/auditor are missing required taskPrompt/permissionMode). No call site was rerouted (loop.ts, plan-runner.ts, review.ts's makeReviewDispatch still call the four builders directly) and no completion-detection/report-parsing logic was added to the adapter (verified by the AC4 file-assert oracle). Gotcha for the NEXT story: a grep-based file-assert oracle scans doc-comment prose too, not just code -- see the patterns.md bullet on this. The likely next story per ADR-0047's scope is either (a) rerouting the four call sites through ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv with zero behavior change, or (b) starting the readBackend per-phase-accessor upgrade; read ADR-0047 in full before choosing either.
